title: trifolium montanum subsp. rupestre
intro: Trifolium montanum subsp. rupestre, commonly known as alpine clover, is a subspecies of the perennial herb Trifolium montanum native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory infections. Bioactive constituents of Trifolium montanum subsp. rupestre include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
